description: This file defines the FloorDivBinary class, which represents a binary expression node for floor division in the Twig templating engine. It extends AbstractBinary and overrides the compile method to generate PHP code that performs floor division, as well as defining the operator method to specify the '/' operator.

classes.name: FloorDivBinary
classes.description: Represents a floor division binary operator node in the Twig expression AST.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform floor division, converting the result to an integer.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol '/', used in the generated code.
